proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Lobbying Report
proposals.proponent: Zevin Asset Management, on behalf of William Creighton, and co-filers Congregation of Sisters of St. Agnes, First Affirmative Financial Network, LLC, Friends Fiduciary Corporation, and Sisters of Charity of the Blessed Virgin Mary
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing AbbVie's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association memberships and oversight of lobbying payments.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Compensation Committee Drug Pricing Report
proposals.proponent: United Church Funds, and co-filers, including Bon Secours Mercy Health, Sisters of Charity of Saint Elizabeth, Sisters of Providence, Mother Joseph Province, and Trinity Health
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Compensation Committee to report annually on whether risks related to public concern over drug pricing are integrated into senior executive incentive compensation.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Independent Chair
proposals.proponent: The Employees' Retirement System of Rhode Island and co-filer Vermont Pension Investment Committee
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, phased in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
